requirement: Predict which customers will cancel next month
reasons: Logic must be learned from historical data; nobody can write the rule by hand. | Input is structured/tabular, so classical ML is enough and cheaper than deep learning.
risks: Model accuracy degrades as customer/market behaviour drifts. | Predictions are probabilistic, so a business owner must accept some error rate.
first_next_step: Pull historical data, define the target and success metric, and build a simple baseline.
